Name: Kirby Plush (AT)
Author: smampai
Description:
This mod uses Alternative Textures to turn the Junimo Plush into a big Kirby. There are 7 variations to choose from, so you can have different kirbs! 

[b]How to use:
[/b]Place down the Junimo Plush and it will randomly pick one variation of the texture to turn into. If you want to choose which specific texture you want, use the [b]Paint Bucket[/b] tool you get from Robin's. Enjoy!

Manifest.Name: AT Kirby Plush
Manifest.Description: Turns the Junimo Plush into Kirby
